name: network-protocols
description: Use when the user asks about TCP state, TIME_WAIT, the three-way handshake, congestion control, CUBIC vs BBR, Nagle and TCP_NODELAY, retransmission, MTU, QUIC, HTTP/3, socket tuning or tcpdump. Produces transport-level diagnosis and socket and kernel settings. Not for HTTP API design (use backend-api-design) or game netcode (use multiplayer-netcode).

findings.excerpt: ss -tinp state established '( dport = :443 )'     # per-socket cwnd/rtt/retrans
